description: Happy path: `verify_raven_to_postgres.py --module students` against a RavenDB/PostgreSQL pair containing exactly 1 organization, 1 institute, and 1 student (same dataset as the etl_module_students fixture, already migrated). The Students pair matches 1:1 with zero field mismatches, prints the verbatim audit banner/table/totals/success lines, writes the exhaustive parity report JSON with overall_status PASS, and exits 0.
notes: All expected strings, column widths, status logic, and the report shape are lifted verbatim from verify_raven_to_postgres.py - nothing hand-invented. PII synthesized per the adapter (same synthetic dataset as etl_module_students). Nondeterministic values (timestamps, report filename, totals embedding live counts) are asserted by rule. Capture against a live legacy run to set validated_against_legacy=true.

environment.working_directory: repository root (python scripts/verify_raven_to_postgres.py --module students), or inside the rpg-migrator container where the runbook invokes it with WORKDIR /app/scripts

config.RAVEN_CERT_FILE: certs/test-client-cert.pfx (resolvable from scripts/ or repo root; synthetic fixture)

given.filter_note: 'students' matches the spec whose domain/collection/table lowercased equals 'students' -> exactly 1 pair selected (domain 'Students', collection 'Students', table 'student')
given.raven_state: Orgs=1, Institutes=1, Students=1 (identical documents to the etl_module_students fixture, including @metadata ids ending a1/b1/c1)
given.postgres_state: organization=1, institute=1, student=1 rows produced by the students ETL from those exact documents (ids 00000000-...-a1/b1/c1, all columns populated per the ETL mappings)

stdout_verbatim_lines: RAVENDB -> POSTGRESQL COMPLETE 42-COLLECTION DATA PARITY AUDIT

stdout_verbatim_lines_assert_rules.banner_rule: three '=' rules of 115 chars bracket the audit banner; banner text exactly 'RAVENDB -> POSTGRESQL COMPLETE 42-COLLECTION DATA PARITY AUDIT'
stdout_verbatim_lines_assert_rules.target_lines: URL/db and host:port/db/user interpolated from resolved config; prefix '[+] Target RavenDB:    ' and '[+] Target PostgreSQL: ' verbatim

summary_table.header_row: Domain / Entity          | Collection                | PG Table                  | RavenDB  | PG       | Matched  | Status
summary_table.column_widths: domain<24, collection<26, table<26, counts<8, status<8, ' | ' separators

report_artifact.stdout_line: [+] Detailed Verification Report JSON written to: <absolute-path>

results.fields_audited_count_assert_rule: integer > 0 (declared students_comparisons plus auto-expanded Raven keys present as PG columns; exact value depends on the live schema)

final_lines: [SUCCESS] 100% COMPLETE PARITY CONFIRMED ACROSS ALL 1 TABLES AND 1 RECORDS!

nondeterministic_fields: report payload timestamp_utc (ISO-8601; do not assert literally)
fields_audited_count (depends on live PG columns and Raven document keys present)
known_unstated: divergent cases (unordered offset paging on a live source, missing PG table -> MISSING_TABLE, silent localhost:5432/rpg defaults, --core-only no-op, PKCS#12 temp-key fallback) are reified as open items in specs/migration/parity-verifier.md and deliberately not encoded as passing expectations
the other 41 pairs are not exercised by this fixture; --module students scopes the run to 1 pair
